Holder Jacobs & Co Boosted Celgene (CELG) Holding; Trafelet Brokaw Capital Management LP Lifted Goodyear Tire & Rubr Co (GT) Position by $478,880 as Stock Price Declined
May 1, 2018 - By Peter Erickson
Jacobs & Co increased its stake in Celgene Corp (CELG) by 11% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Jacobs & Co bought 2,925 shares as the company’s stock declined 19.30% with the market. The institutional investor held 29,509 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.04 million, up from 26,584 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Jacobs & Co who had been investing in Celgene Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $66.14 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.95% or $0.83 during the last trading session, reaching $87.93. About 3.90 million shares traded. Celgene Corporation (NASDAQ:CELG) has declined 31.28% since May 1, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 42.83% the S&P500.
Remy Trafelet increased its stake in Goodyear Tire & Rubr Co (GT) by 150.4% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Trafelet Brokaw Capital Management Lp bought 14,965 shares as the company’s stock declined 18.63% with the market. The hedge fund run by Remy Trafelet held 24,915 shares of the automotive aftermarket company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $805,000, up from 9,950 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Trafelet Brokaw Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Goodyear Tire & Rubr Co for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $6.09 billion market cap company. The Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company (NASDAQ:GT) has declined 25.73% since May 1, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 37.28% the S&P500.
